name: Sekai Project
summary: Pioneering Western visual-novel publisher behind English releases of Nekopara, Clannad, Grisaia, and dozens of official 18+ Denpasoft patches.
ranking_rationale: Brought the modern Japanese visual-novel boom to Steam & Western PC players (trade-off: localization wait times on sprawling long VNs can stretch out).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Brought the modern Japanese visual-novel boom to Steam & Western PC players

Broad indie & commercial Japanese VN slate
cons: Localization wait times on sprawling long VNs can stretch out
